# TimeTiles

> TimeTiles is a free Chrome extension for parents who use Google Family Link. It turns Family Link device-time settings into a clear, child-friendly weekly timetable that can be printed.

## Official pages

- [TimeTiles home](https://timetilesfamily.com/): What TimeTiles does, how it handles schedule data locally, and how to install it.
- [Can I print a Google Family Link schedule?](https://timetilesfamily.com/print-family-link-schedule/): Instructions for creating a printable schedule with TimeTiles.
- [How to explain screen-time rules to children](https://timetilesfamily.com/explain-screen-time-rules/): Practical guidance for explaining routines and limits.
- [Privacy policy](https://timetilesfamily.com/privacy/): How TimeTiles handles Family Link schedule data, feedback and donations.

## Key facts

- TimeTiles is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
- Parents set and change the actual device-time rules in Google Family Link.
- TimeTiles creates a friendly printable view of the schedule it reads from a supported Family Link page.
- Family Link schedule data stays in the user's Chrome profile and is not sent to TimeTiles.
